title: Attendance Record Rates on the Late-Cancellation Fee, In-Person Appointments
content:
**Rate clause.** The starting amount of the late-cancellation fee an In-Person Appointments visit carries is raised according to the appointment fee charges on the ledger of the patient's Patient Financial Account. Charges are counted when they are no-show fee or late-cancellation fee charges posted with a date of service less than 12 whole months before the day the fee is decided:

- where the ledger shows **2 or more** such charges, **at least one of them a no-show fee**, the starting amount is raised by half, that is, multiplied by 1.5;
- where the ledger shows **at least 1** such charge but not that combination, it is raised by a quarter, that is, multiplied by 1.25;
- where the ledger shows none, it is taken as it stands, that is, multiplied by 1.

Charges of any other kind on the ledger are not counted for the late-cancellation fee the visit carries.

### Truth table

| No-show fee charges in the window | Late-cancellation fee charges in the window | Total | At least one no-show fee | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | No | 1 (as it stands) |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | Yes | 1.25 |
| 0 | 1 | 1 | No | 1.25 |
| 0 | 2 | 2 | No | 1.25 |
| 0 | 4 | 4 | No | 1.25 |
| 1 | 1 | 2 | Yes | 1.5 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | Yes | 1.5 |

A run of late-cancellation fee charges alone, however many, stays at 1.25; the 1.5 rate needs a total of 2 or more with a no-show fee among them.

### Window (hypothetical dates)

For a fee decided on 2026-11-20, a no-show fee charge with a date of service of 2026-01-15 falls inside the 12 whole months and is counted; one with a date of service of 2025-10-02 does not.

*Hypothetical figure:* a starting amount of $40.00 at the 1.25 rate becomes $50.00; at the 1.5 rate, $60.00.
